name: HEAD CLEANER
source:
What awkward young trans woman Anna wants more than anything else is to get laid, to be DESIRED. But she gets more than what she bargained for when she encounters the parasitic slime girl, Ghell. Is the best sex in her life worth losing herself over - and does it matter?

[From [url=https://air-gong.itch.io/head-cleaner]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
笨拙局促的年轻跨性别女性安娜最渴望的，莫过于尝一回云雨之欢、感受被人渴求的滋味。然而当她遇上寄生史莱姆娘盖尔时，得到的却远远超出了她的预期。用迷失自我换取一生中最极致的欢愉究竟值不值得——而这又真的重要吗？
